scripts.dev:backend: cd server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && . ./.env && set +a; fi && PORT=3030 go run main.go
scripts.build:backend: cd server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && . ./.env && set +a; fi && go build -o mewmer-server .
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm check && pnpm build
scripts.check:backend: cd server && gofmt -l . && go test ./... && go vet ./... && go build -o /dev/null .
scripts.check:app: cd app && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.migrate: cd server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && . ./.env && set +a; fi && for f in migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f "$f"; done
scripts.create:admin: cd server && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && . ./.env && set +a; fi && go run ./cmd/create-admin
